alt_names: Principality of Armenia under the presiding princes

land.text: Armenia under Theodore Rshtuni, presiding prince 638-645, recognised by Constans II after his 643 victory

predecessors.note: The principality's office list opens earlier (Mjej II Gnuni 628-635, David Saharuni 635-638); the Cliopatria shape begins in 638.

land.text: Ashot I, who 'declares himself King of Armenia' in 884 (recognised by the caliph in 885 and by Basil I in 886)

capitals.name: Dvin (Dabil)
capitals.note: Seat of the ostikan; around 780 the Qaysid emirs took Dvin and the ostikan moved to Bardha'a in Arran. Coordinates approximate.

rulers.name: Theodore Rshtuni
rulers.title: presiding prince (ishkhan)
rulers.note: Years are the page's 'selected' list and leave gaps (645-654, 658-662, 711-732, 744-761, 775-806, 826-830, 851-862); the page notes its sources conflict on chronology. Earlier: Mjej II Gnuni 628-635, David Saharuni 635-638.

correction.text: Armenia under the presiding prince Theodore Rshtuni

keyframe_review.note: 73,677 km2 (72,800 on the gazetteer), bbox 41.5-47.0 E. The page gives no area. The Kingdom of Armenia dossier marks this row 'wrong' as the Kingdom of Armenia (abolished 428) and asks for this principality dossier; Cliopatria shape unchanged, only the state it belongs to changes (this principality, not the kingdom).

correction.text: Armenia after the first Arab conquest

keyframe_review.note: 46,791 km2, the shape shrinks by 36 percent at 644 and the north-west is lost. The page puts the Arab conquest at 645/646 (Muslim sources, Habib ibn Maslama); no page dates the 644 step. Cliopatria shape unchanged (kingdom-of-armenia_644 row), only the state it belongs to changes.

correction.text: the last Cliopatria outline, kept for the presiding princes' Armenia under Arab suzerainty

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 647-884 (Cliopatria's Armenia row ends in 646). The page gives no frontier or area: Arminiya was divided into four regions (Albania, Iberia, the Aras area, Taron) and the princes ruled the Armenian part; the 646 outline (about 46,300 km2 on the gazetteer) is kept as the conservative reading, against the 99,600 km2 of the 886 Bagratid shape that the successor inherited. Vassal tint to the Caliphate (Byzantium 657-661 and in 703-705 revolts); the suzerains' dossiers carry the relation.

ledger.note: 638: Theodore Rshtuni becomes presiding prince of Armenia. The page lists 'Theodore Rshtuni, 638-645' after David Saharuni (635-638) and Mjej II Gnuni (628-635); in 643 he 'defeats an Arab invasion and is recognized by Constans II'.

region.text: the strip between the 638 and 644 outlines, lost to the Arab conquest

ledger.note: 644-646: the Arab conquest cuts the north-west of Armenia away. The page: Arab expedition 639/640 (Arabic sources), 642 Dvin sacked, 'Muslim sources place the actual conquest in 645/646 under Habib ibn Maslama al-Fihri'; Cliopatria's shape shrinks in 644. The year and the lost strip are bridging.

705: Arab rule is formalised and the lands are grouped as al-Arminiya. 'Under Abd al-Malik, Arab rule was formalized, and in 705 the province was grouped as al-Arminiya'; the rebel princes of the revolt of 703-705 were executed that year.
c. 780: the Qaysid emirs take Dvin. 'Around 780, the Qaysid emirs took Dvin, and the ostikan moved to Bardha'a in Arran.'

region.text: the lands of Ashot I's kingdom

ledger.note: 884: Ashot I declares himself King of Armenia. The infobox ends the emirate in 884, 'Ashot I declares himself King of Armenia'; Caliph al-Mu'tamid recognised him in 885 and Basil I in 886.

wars.name: Arab conquest of Armenia
wars.outcome: Arab expeditions reached Armenia in 639/640 and sacked Dvin in 642; Theodore Rshtuni beat an Arab invasion in 643; Muslim sources place the conquest in 645/646.
wars.note: The page notes Sebeos is held more reliable than the Arabic chronology for the early raids.

wars.name: Constans II's Armenian campaign and the Arab invasion of 654
wars.outcome: Rshtuni submitted to Muslim overlordship in 653, Constans campaigned and the Arabs invaded in 654; Hamazasp IV Mamikonian was installed in 655 and Byzantine overlordship returned in 657 with the First Fitna; Mu'awiya reasserted authority in 661.

wars.name: Armenian revolt of 703-705
wars.outcome: An Armenian revolt with Byzantine aid ended with the rebel princes executed in 705.

wars.name: Revolt of 774-775 (Battle of Bagrevand)
wars.outcome: The revolt was suppressed at the Battle of Bagrevand in April 775.

certainty.note: No page gives a frontier for any year; the Cliopatria 638-646 shapes are kept, then the 646 outline.

sources.title: Principality of Armenia
sources.note: The URL redirects to 'Arminiya (Emirate of Armenia)': the Arab province page that also lists the presiding princes of Armenia, 638-884; no area or frontier.

notes: Cliopatria carries this state only for 638-646, inside its 'Kingdom of Armenia' row (shapes kingdom-of-armenia_638 and _644, which the kingdom-of-armenia dossier marks 'wrong' and hands to a principality dossier). This dossier carries them as new keyframes principality-of-armenia_638 and _644 that point at the Cliopatria shapes (cliopatria_names stays empty so the 30 other Kingdom of Armenia shapes are not claimed twice). The page opened is the Arab province article Arminiya, reached by the title 'Principality of Armenia'; it treats the principality (ishkhan) and the Arab province together, so territorial claims are thin: the 647-884 keyframe reuses the 646 outline (low confidence). The Marzpanate of Armenia (428-636) and the Qaysid emirs of Manzikert (780) need dossiers elsewhere. Overlordship changes (Byzantine 628-653, Caliphate 653-657, Byzantine 657-661, Caliphate again from 661) are not ledgered here: the suzerains' dossiers carry vassal_start/vassal_end with counterpart principality-of-armenia. Ruler list is the page's 'selected years' list and has gaps. wikidata null.
